name: align_citation_rls_with_profile_values
query:
DROP POLICY citations_student_select ON public.citations;
CREATE POLICY citations_student_select ON public.citations FOR SELECT USING (
  is_active IS TRUE
  AND is_validated IS TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.citation_scopes scope
    JOIN public.levels level ON level.id = scope.level_id
    LEFT JOIN public.series series ON series.id = scope.series_id
    JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id = auth.uid()
    WHERE scope.citation_id = citations.id
      AND level.name = profile.school_level
      AND (scope.series_id IS NULL OR series.name = profile.series)
  )
);
DROP POLICY citation_scopes_student_select ON public.citation_scopes;
CREATE POLICY citation_scopes_student_select ON public.citation_scopes FOR SELECT USING (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.levels level
    LEFT JOIN public.series series ON series.id = citation_scopes.series_id
    JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id = auth.uid()
    WHERE level.id = citation_scopes.level_id
      AND level.name = profile.school_level
      AND (citation_scopes.series_id IS NULL OR series.name = profile.series)
  )
);
